title: Kathmandu Heritage Day
summary: Swayambhunath, Patan Durbar Square, and Boudhanath with a licensed city guide.
overview: A single day that explains why Kathmandu is more than a trek starting point. You move between hilltop stupas, palace squares, and living courtyards with someone who knows which stories are worth the time.
Hotel pickup in Thamel is included. The pace is walking-friendly, with time for tea rather than a checklist sprint.
imageAlt: Temple and stupa architecture in Kathmandu

itinerary.title: Swayambhunath
itinerary.detail: Monkey temple ridge and a first view over the valley.

itinerary.title: Patan
itinerary.detail: Durbar Square, courtyards, and lunch in the old city.

itinerary.title: Boudhanath
itinerary.detail: Circumambulation of the great stupa and return to your hotel.

faqs.question: Is this tour good on an arrival day?
faqs.answer: A lighter half-day version is better after a long flight. The full day works best once you have slept.

metaDescription: Private Kathmandu heritage tour of Swayambhunath, Patan, and Boudhanath with a local guide.

title: Kathmandu Valley Temples
summary: Pashupatinath, Bhaktapur, and a quieter valley look beyond Thamel.
overview: This day is for travelers who want the valley’s living religious life and its best-preserved medieval city. Bhaktapur rewards slow walking; Pashupatinath rewards respectful attention.
We keep the group small and skip sites that would only repeat the heritage day if you are doing both.
imageAlt: Historic brick square in the Kathmandu Valley

itinerary.title: Pashupatinath
itinerary.detail: Riverside temples with context from your guide.

itinerary.title: Bhaktapur
itinerary.detail: Durbar Square, side lanes, and time to wander.

faqs.question: Can I combine this with the heritage day?
faqs.answer: Yes. Many guests do one day of each before a trek or bus to Pokhara.

metaDescription: Day tour of Pashupatinath and Bhaktapur with a private guide from Kathmandu.

title: Pokhara Lakes & Viewpoints
summary: Phewa Lake, World Peace Pagoda, and a Sarangkot or lakeside evening.
overview: Pokhara is where most of our treks and the daily bus meet. This day tour is the right way to land: a boat, a short climb to the pagoda, and time by the lake before a trek starts or after one ends.
We can add Sarangkot for sunrise if you overnight in Pokhara.

itinerary.title: Lake and pagoda
itinerary.detail: Boat across Phewa and a walk up to the pagoda.

itinerary.title: Lakeside
itinerary.detail: Caves or Devi’s Fall on request, then free time.

faqs.question: Can I do this after the bus from Kathmandu?
faqs.answer: The afternoon is enough for the lake. The full day is better if you arrive the evening before.

metaTitle: Pokhara Day Tour — Lake and Viewpoints
metaDescription: Pokhara sightseeing with Phewa Lake and the World Peace Pagoda, easy to pair with the Kathmandu bus.

title: Chitwan Jungle Stay
summary: Jungle walks, a river trip, and a night in the Terai after the mountains.
overview: Chitwan is the contrast piece: warm air, grassland, and a chance to see rhino from a jeep or on foot with a park guide. We book a lodge that is comfortable without being a resort circus.
The drive from Kathmandu or Pokhara is straightforward, and we can time it after a trek.
imageAlt: Wildlife landscape in a subtropical reserve

itinerary.title: Travel to Chitwan
itinerary.detail: Drive from Kathmandu or Pokhara and an evening briefing.

itinerary.title: Park activities
itinerary.detail: Safari, canoe, and a nature walk.

itinerary.title: Return
itinerary.detail: Morning birding if you wish, then drive back.

faqs.question: Are wildlife sightings guaranteed?
faqs.answer: No ethical operator guarantees animals. Rhino sightings are common; tiger sightings are rare and never promised.

metaDescription: 3-day Chitwan wildlife stay with safari and lodge, arranged from Kathmandu or Pokhara.

title: Bhaktapur & Patan Walk
summary: Two Newari cities on foot, with courtyards most coach tours skip.
overview: A walking-focused day for people who care about craft and architecture more than monuments ticked off a list. Patan in the morning, Bhaktapur after lunch.

itinerary.title: Two cities
itinerary.detail: Guided walking in Patan, transfer, then Bhaktapur at your own pace with the guide nearby.

faqs.question: How much walking?
faqs.answer: About 6–8 kilometers across the day, mostly flat lanes and squares.

metaDescription: Small-group walking tour of Patan and Bhaktapur from Kathmandu.

title: Nagarkot Sunrise Escape
summary: An overnight on the valley rim for a Himalayan sunrise without a trek.
overview: Nagarkot is the simplest mountain view we sell: drive up from Kathmandu, sleep above the haze, and watch the range at dawn. Ideal before or after a trek if you want one easy scenic night.
imageAlt: Sunrise over a distant mountain range

itinerary.title: Drive up
itinerary.detail: Afternoon transfer and sunset if the sky is clear.

itinerary.title: Sunrise and return
itinerary.detail: Dawn viewpoint and drive back to Kathmandu.

faqs.question: Is the sunrise guaranteed?
faqs.answer: Clouds happen. We choose the clearer months and a lodge with a real viewpoint, but weather is weather.

metaDescription: Overnight Nagarkot sunrise trip from Kathmandu with private transfer.

title: Kathmandu, Pokhara & Chitwan
summary: The classic first Nepal journey: city, lake, and jungle — with our bus on the highway.
overview: This is the trip we build for guests who are not trekking but still want Nepal done properly. Two days in the valley, the tourist bus to Pokhara, a lake day, then Chitwan and the road home.
You travel with our team’s timing, not a random coach connection.
imageAlt: Travelers on a scenic mountain road

itinerary.title: Kathmandu
itinerary.detail: Heritage touring and a free evening.

itinerary.title: Pokhara
itinerary.detail: Morning tourist bus and a lake day.

itinerary.title: Chitwan and return
itinerary.detail: Safari day and drive back to Kathmandu.

faqs.question: Can I upgrade the bus?
faqs.answer: Yes. Deluxe and sofa-seat coaches are available on the same route — see the bus page.
